# Find files and project information
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Use the sidebar sections to browse files, search text, review local changes, and look up hosted issues.

## Open a sidebar section

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/sidebars.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/files.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/needs_you_workspaces.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SidebarIconBar.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FilesPanel.vue -->

Select a section from the sidebar icon bar. **File explorer** browses project files; **Source control** shows local Git changes; **Code hosting** shows issues and pull requests for the selected workspace's remote repository.

![The File explorer sidebar section with the folders and the files at the root of the repository.](/screenshots/features/file_explorer.png){width=300}

## Search within files

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/file_search.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/FileSearchPanel.vue -->

Open **Search in files**, enter text, and choose **Match case** or **Regular expression** when needed. Select a result line to open the file at that location.

## Review local changes

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/sidebars/source_control.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/SourceControlPanel.vue -->

Open **Source control** to inspect changed files and select a file to review its diff. These changes come from the local repository.

![The Source control sidebar section with the commit message box, the commit button, and the list of the changed files.](/screenshots/features/source_control.png){width=300}
